articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin pulls back below $60,000, stock rally fades, as tariffs re-enter the picture
articles.snippet: The Trump Administration could unveil tariff hikes against China, Japan, South Korea and other countries as soon as this week, according to a WSJ report.

articles.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
articles.snippet: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

articles.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
articles.snippet: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

articles.title: Europol follows $28.5M crypto trail in streaming piracy crackdown
articles.snippet: Authorities from 11 countries worked with Binance, Coinbase and Chainalysis to trace financial transactions and disrupt illegal streaming services.

articles.title: Bitcoin slides amid US tariff nerves as Anthropic falls below IPO price
articles.snippet: Bitcoin gave up gains above $60,000 as tariff concerns weighed on US stocks and Anthropic shares hit new lows below $76.
